elements.problem: Three parts: (a) thoughts/plans of self-harm or suicide in past month, (b) act of self-harm in past year, (c) act of suicide in past year. The concepts for all three are present (Thoughts of self harm / Suicidal thoughts / Planning suicide; History of deliberate self harm; History of attempted suicide). The time comparators are in the wrong direction: by the house convention (`(< (onset X) (time_ago 3 days))` = onset within the last 3 days; `(>= (onset X) (time_ago 24 hours))` = onset at least 24 hours ago), `(<= (onset X) (time_ago 1 months))` selects onsets at least a month ago, i.e. older history, and `(<= ... (time_ago 1 years))` selects acts more than a year old. The page wants the opposite (within the last month / year). Secondary: the unqualified Suicidal thoughts and Thoughts of self harm needed for part (a) are not in check_for (they are only task triggers), so part (a) cannot be recorded from this page; and `onset` of a 'History of ...' situation is the time the history was recorded, not when the act happened.

By the house convention `(< (onset X) (time_ago N))` means 'within the last N' and `(>= ...)` means 'at least N ago'; the rule uses `(<= (onset X) (time_ago 1 months))` and `(<= ... rule_level_problems.problem: The check list and the high-risk rule disagree on what the nurse can record. The high-risk rule's Q3 branch needs unqualified Suicidal thoughts / Thoughts of self harm with an onset, but check_for only offers the Current-qualified forms plus unqualified Planning suicide and the two History situations. 'Thoughts in the past month' can therefore only reach the rule if recorded on another page or as a warning sign. (The unqualified forms cannot be added to check_for as-is because they are in the task's own due_to; the trigger set would need re-thinking, e.g. trigger on the events and the Current-qualified findings only.)

Any Thoughts of self harm (and descendants Suicidal thoughts, Planning suicide) at any time raises Urgent, so a patient the flowchart classifies Low risk (thoughts a month ago, calm) is still Urgent. Defensible from the header 'attempted/considered', but the page sends Low risk to routine management ('Manage below'), so the priority and the low-risk diagnosis will disagree for the same patient.

summary: The high-risk rule's past-month/past-year branch uses `<=` against time_ago, which under the house convention selects history older than the window rather than within it, so the page's Q3 = Yes patients are excluded. The low-risk rule has no positive anchor and ignores Q3, so the Q3 = No -> Low risk branch is lost and a calm-history-free but distressed patient gets no classification. Concepts, the Current-qualified Q2 encoding, the Q4 findings and the Urgent priority on attempt/thoughts/High risk are otherwise sound; the past-month thoughts cannot be recorded from this page's check list.
